active.description: The view that the board opens on, or null while the state holds no view.

visible.description: The sections that a block's card shows, by the block's id, for each card that hides a section. A card without an entry shows both.

description: The dock's views, the folders that group them, the active view and the sections that each block's card shows.

name.description: The name that the user gives the view.

folder.description: The folder that the view sits in, or null at the top.

index.description: The key that orders the view among the views and folders of its folder, compared as a string.

grid.description: Which panels the view shows, and where.

View.description: A view: a grid of panels, with a name, in a place in the navigation.

FolderId.description: The id of a folder, which never changes.

orientation.description: How the top split divides. Each split inside divides the other way from the split that holds it.

children.description: What the top split holds, in order.

items.description: The share of a split that one of its children takes, a ratio above 0.

sizes.description: The share of each child, ratios that sum to 1.

rails.description: The rails of the view, by the edge that each sits on.

Grid.description: Where a view places its panels: nested splits of tab groups, and a rail on each side.

Node.description: What a split holds: a split or a tab group.

children.description: What the split holds, in order.

items.description: The share of a split that one of its children takes, a ratio above 0.

sizes.description: The share of each child, ratios that sum to 1.

Split.description: A split, which divides the other way from the split that holds it.

panels.description: Its panels, in the order of their tabs.

TabGroup.description: A tab group, with a tab for each of its panels.

Panel.description: A panel: the card of one of the board's blocks, by the block's id, or the UI of one of the app's plugins, by the id of the plugin's class.

panels.description: Its panels, in the order of their tabs.

collapsed.description: Whether the rail shows its tabs alone.

size.description: Its width in pixels while it is open, 260 by default.

collapsed_size.description: Its width in pixels while it is collapsed, 35 by default.

Rail.description: A rail on an edge of the view, with a tab for each of its panels.

name.description: The name that the user gives the folder.

folder.description: The folder that the folder sits in, or null at the top.

index.description: The key that orders the folder among the views and folders of its folder, compared as a string.

Folder.description: A folder, which groups views and other folders in the navigation.

ViewId.description: The id of a view, which never changes.

Section.description: A section of a block's card.
